text: 1. Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA 2. Applicants should have the equivalent of a high school education 3. Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school 4. Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general 5. Applicants should have good command of English and the ability to take courses in English; Applicants are required to submit the certificates of 90 or more in TOEFL, 5.5 or more in IELTS or any other proofs about English level. All the applicants should pass the English Level Test at the beginning of the first semester in BUAA
